subject: HarborPay security / MAP kickoff — SOC2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA, retention
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@harborpay.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: security@harborpay.com, lena.ortiz@harborpay.com
Date: 2028-07-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: HarborPay evaluation kickoff & security questions

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the demo last week. HarborPay's InfoSec leads want to formalize a short MAP so we can get to a decision by early August. To scope the evaluation we need:

- SOC 2: Which trust services are in scope (Security / Availability / Confidentiality)?
- SIG/CAIQ: Is there a completed CAIQ matrix and can you share your answers and supporting artifact list?
- DPA: Can Redwood sign HarborPay's standard DPA? Are there carve-outs for subprocessor locations (we require EU residency for cardholder-adjacent logs)?
- Data retention: What are default retention windows for logs, prompts, and model outputs? Can we request a shorter retention (30 days) for EU data?
- Evidence timeline: When can you deliver SOC 2 report or SOC 2 audit readiness artifacts and the CAIQ pack?

We're creating a one-page MAP to include milestone owners and dates — can you provide a draft MAP and pointer to the DocuSign link for a DPA? Our target: decision week of Aug 7.

Attached: HarborPay_Security_Reqs.pdf (their internal checklist)

Appreciate quick confirmation on feasibility and an initial timeline.

Best,
Amit Shah
Head of Platform Security — HarborPay
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@harborpay.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-25T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: HarborPay evaluation kickoff & security questions

Hi Amit —

Thanks for the clear checklist — very helpful. Quick responses inline, plus next steps and an initial MAP draft attached.

- SOC 2 scope: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in scope for Security and Availability; Confidentiality controls are documented but not included in the audited scope. We can provide the most recent report under NDA / secure share.
- SIG/CAIQ: We maintain a completed CAIQ and an artifacts inventory. I will attach the CAIQ export and an artifact index; we typically complete the CAIQ export within 3–5 business days for a new evaluation request.
- DPA: Redwood uses a standard DPA; we can review HarborPay's redlines. Legal has asked for a limited EU subprocessor commitment for cardholder-adjacent logs — I'll loop in Jon as we discuss carve-outs.
- Data retention: Default retention windows are: short-term logs 90 days, prompts/outputs 30 days unless customer opts in to longer retention for debugging. EU-specific retention can be tightened to 30 days for PII scopes with a contractual amendment (this is feasible but needs DPA appendix).
- Evidence timeline: CAIQ export + artifact index — 5 business days. SOC 2 report — we can deliver the redacted report within 3 business days after an executed NDA; full report access is via our secure portal.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_draft.xlsx (proposed milestones and owners)

Next suggested steps:
1) Jon (Legal) to confirm DPA carve-out feasibility and provide counterparty language.
2) Security to deliver CAIQ export and artifact mapping.
3) We exchange DocuSign links for DPA signature and set an artifact delivery slot for the week of July 29.

We can aim for a decision in the week of Aug 7 if artifact delivery and review happen on the July 29–Aug 3 cadence. If that timeline works, I'll convert the draft MAP into the shared HubSpot MAP record.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-25T14:28:00Z
Subject: Re: HarborPay evaluation kickoff & security questions — DPA notes

Hi Amit / Soojin —

Quick legal input on the DPA carve-outs:
- Redwood can reasonably commit to EU-only processing for cardholder-adjacent logs if HarborPay makes that a contractual requirement and enumerates the relevant data categories. We'll accept a targeted subprocessor restriction limited to the log types you identify.
- We prefer to avoid open-ended residency guarantees for general telemetry; instead we add a scoped clause for cardholder-adjacent data combined with an audit right on subprocessor locations.
- Retention: we can add a DPA appendix to enforce 30-day retention for specific datasets and a process for exception requests (e.g., fraud investigations) that require explicit written approval.

Attached: DPA_redlines.docx (high-level markup)

If HarborPay can send a short list of the exact log classes that must remain EU-resident, we can convert the DPA redlines into a DocuSign-ready agreement today.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-07-26T08:15:00Z
Subject: Re: HarborPay evaluation kickoff & security questions

Thanks, Soojin and Jonas. That approach sounds workable. Two quick asks:

1) Can you provide a completed SIG/CAIQ export? HarborPay InfoSec prefers a filled matrix rather than spot Q&A. We need the artifacts index alongside it.
2) Can you confirm when the SOC 2 Type II report will be available to share (we can accept redacted PDF)? HarborPay's procurement committee requires either the report or an auditor's contact to confirm current attestation status.

We'd like to schedule a 30-minute artifact walk-through with your security owner on Aug 2 at 10:00 AM CEST (HarborPay can host Zoom). Let us know who will attend.

Attached: harborpay_audit_calendar.ics (proposed meeting)

Regards,
Amit

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-26T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: HarborPay evaluation kickoff & security questions — CAIQ & artifact plan

Hi Amit —

I'll own the SIG/CAIQ delivery and the artifact index. Plan below: 

- CAIQ export: I will run a current CAIQ extraction and mark items that are covered by our SOC 2 documentation vs. other artifacts. Target delivery: 5 business days (by 2028-08-01).
- Artifact inventory: CSV mapping (control -> artifact -> access instructions). I'll include links to redacted SOC 2 snippets in the secure portal and a short readme explaining access process.
- SOC 2 report: We can provide a redacted PDF once the NDA is signed; I will also provide the auditor contact if you need direct verification.
- Retention & EU residency: Technical implementation for a 30-day retention window on EU-tagged prompts/outputs exists as a configuration; the DPA appendix will operationalize the commitment and the process for exception approvals.
- Milestones (proposed MAP):
   * 2028-07-29: DPA counterparty items finalized (Legal / HarborPay)
   * 2028-07-31: DocuSign executed DPA
   * 2028-08-01: CAIQ + artifact inventory delivered by Redwood Security
   * 2028-08-02: Artifact walk-through (30 min) with HarborPay InfoSec
   * 2028-08-03 to 2028-08-06: HarborPay evidence review window
   * 2028-08-07: Decision meeting

Attached: sig_caiq_inventory.csv (skeleton)

If this milestone sequence looks good, Soojin can publish the MAP to the HubSpot deal and I will schedule the artifact handoff.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick back-and-forth. I've converted the draft into the HubSpot MAP and attached a concise MAP summary PDF for your review. Key commitments below (condensed):

- CAIQ & artifacts: Delivery by 2028-08-01; sig/CAIQ export + artifact index.
- Artifact walkthrough: 2028-08-02, 10:00 CEST.
- Evidence review window: 2028-08-03 to 2028-08-06.
- Decision: 2028-08-07 (HarborPay procurement).
- Contingency: if SOC 2 redacted report is delayed, we will provide auditor contact and scoped artifact evidence to keep the review on schedule.

DocuSign (DPA): https://docusign.com/link/dpa-harborpay-hp4521
HubSpot MAP: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HP-4521
Drive MAP draft: https://drive.redwood.ai/Shared/HarborPay/MAP/Redwood_MAP_draft.xlsx

Attached: MAP-final-summary.pdf

Please reply with any changes to milestone owners or dates. If no changes by EOD 2028-07-29 we'll treat this as the committed MAP and move forward with artifact delivery.

Best,
